name: Viddzerkaleni
source:
Once bound by nobility and slavery – now driven by healing, rebellion, and self-discovery. They share the same goal, but walk opposite paths. Will you preserve their bond or break it forever? Your choice will shape the ideals that shape the world.

[From [url=https://nabulagamesgmailcom.itch.io/mirrored]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们曾被贵族身份与奴役关系束缚，如今则为疗愈、反抗和自我发现而前行。他们拥有相同的目标，却走上相反的道路。你会守住彼此的羁绊，还是让它永远断裂？你的选择，将塑造那些影响世界的理念。

[摘自[url=https://nabulagamesgmailcom.itch.io/mirrored]Itch.io[/url]]
